issue.title: Don't send a scheduled export when the report is empty
issue.body:
Our daily "Refunds" export goes to four people every morning, including the
days when there were no refunds at all. Those emails say "(0 rows)" and the
attachment is just the header line. Could a schedule skip sending when there is
nothing in the report, or have an option for that? In a quiet week that's most
of the email we get from Ledgerline.

input.title: Skip scheduled exports when the report has no rows
input.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In runScheduledExport, after listForReport returns, return early when rows is empty, before writing the file and calling sendEmail. Still call reportRepo.markScheduleRun with nextRunAt(schedule.cadence, now) so the schedule advances and the empty run is not retried every tick. An opt-in per-schedule flag (for example skipIfEmpty, default false) would keep current behaviour for anyone who wants the zero-row email; it would need a schema field in ReportSchedule and the schedule API as well.
